# hcloudplus_project_invitation (Resource)

A pending project membership invitation. Invitations are immutable: changing email or role forces replacement (Hetzner does not expose an update endpoint). Accepted invitations continue to exist as project members, which this resource does not manage.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hcloudplus_project" "example" {
  name = "infra-prod"
}

resource "hcloudplus_project_invitation" "teammate" {
  project_id = hcloudplus_project.example.id
  email      = "alice@example.com"
  role       = "admin"

  # Optional: when true, Terraform refreshes see the invite as expired and
  # recreate it on the next plan so the target user gets a fresh email.
  reinvite_on_expiry = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) Email address of the invitee. Hetzner accepts any syntactically valid email; it does not validate deliverability.
- `project_id` (Number) ID of the project to invite the user into.
- `role` (String) Role to grant on acceptance. One of: admin, member, restricted.

### Optional

- `reinvite_on_expiry` (Boolean) If true, Read will check whether the invitation has expired; if so, the resource is marked for replacement on the next plan (a fresh invitation is created and the stale one is revoked). Defaults to false. This is the only way to get automatic re-invitation without a manual `-replace`.

### Read-Only

- `accepted` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the invitation was accepted, or empty if still pending.
- `created` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the invitation was sent.
- `expired` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the invitation expired (Hetzner times invitations out after some period), or empty if still valid. A non-empty value on refresh means the invite can no longer be accepted by the recipient. Combine with `terraform apply -replace` or the `reinvite_on_expiry` attribute to mint a fresh invitation.
- `id` (String) Numeric invitation ID as a string.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import format: <project_id>:<invitation_id>
terraform import hcloudplus_project_invitation.teammate 14138093:1111279
```
